messages:
Maya (CSM): @Ravi welcome! kicking off Sunnyvale MedTech pilot onboarding. primary goal: integrate Redwood API for triage assistant and validate clinical prompts. propose timeline: week 1 infra + auth, week 2 prompts & evals, week 3 integration + UAT. can you confirm stakeholders and any data residency constraints? :wave:
Eli (Solutions Eng): I can own model selection and perf baselines. Suggest starting with a quantized Llama-like variant. initial perf targets: p50 < 180ms, p95 < 400ms. I'll deliver a benchmark script.
Priya (Implementation): I'll schedule infra window. need network whitelist (10.2.3.0/24) and SSO metadata (SAML). also confirm whether logs need to be forwarded to their Splunk instance.
Ravi (Sunnyvale PM): Thanks — stakeholders: Ravi (PM), Dr. Chen (Clinical lead), Jamie (IT). Data residency: US-only. Budget approval is a potential renewal risk in ~90 days; would like a milestone check at day 45.
Maya (CSM): Noted. Draft success criteria: 1) intent match >= 80% on pilot eval set, 2) latency p95 <= 400ms, 3) clinician acceptance NPS >= 4 in pilot survey. Agree or suggest changes?
Carlos (Enablement): I'll run two enablement sessions: dev onboarding (30m) and clinician validation workshop (45m). Draft decks by Thu.
Eli (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet for the initial service role: ```json
{"role": "service", "scopes": ["generate", "embeddings"]}
```
Priya (Implementation): Rollout plan suggestion: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days with automated rollback to hosted-small model if error rate > 2%.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: kickoff call scheduled Fri 14:00 PST — calendar invite sent.
Maya (CSM): Next steps: confirm stakeholder list + respond to whitelist request by EOD Wed. I'll create a shared doc for prompts & evals and post link here once ready.
Ravi (Sunnyvale PM): Confirming stakeholders. I'll send SSO metadata by tomorrow. For PHI, we'll pseudonymize before sending logs. also tagging budget owner: Jamie will loop finance.
Maya (CSM): Thanks. Tagging follow-ups: @Eli please add perf doc; @Priya please create infra checklist; @Carlos please prepare training slides. :thumbsup:
Eli (Solutions Eng): On it — I'll add perf targets and a simple benchmark (curl + sample payloads).
Priya (Implementation): Network ticket created, ETA for whitelist completion: Wed EOD.
Carlos (Enablement): Draft slides uploaded to shared doc, requesting feedback from clinical team.
Maya (CSM): I'll run weekly syncs Tuesdays 10:00am PST during the pilot; first recap after kickoff. If cadence is an issue, flag here. :calendar:
Ravi (Sunnyvale PM): All noted. excited to get started.
(onboarding-bot): This thread will be archived after 90 days unless pinned.
